+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '80'
+title: 'AG-9: AgentWriter writes, edits and removes agent folders in the user or project layer'
+---
+## What
+Add the write core of AG-9 (D87, D175). It has no tool code. The tool operations of the next task use it.
+
+Make the new file `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Registry/AgentWriter.swift`:
+- `public enum AgentWriteLayer: String, Sendable, CaseIterable { case user, project }`. The default is `.user`. The names and the values are the same as the `layer` option of the `skills` tool (SK-6).
+- `struct AgentWriter` over `AgentRegistry.localLayers`. The target layer is the highest local layer whose `DotfolderStack.Layer.source` is `.user` or `.project`. A `.defaults` layer and each marketplace layer are read-only. When the stack has no layer of that source, the writer gives the error `layerUnavailable(AgentWriteLayer)`.
+- The folder of an agent in a layer:
+  - id `default` (`AgentCatalog.defaultAgentID`): the layer root. Its document `AGENT.md` is the root `AGENT.md` (in the app `Agents/AGENT.md`).
+  - each other id: `<root>/<id>/`. When only the dotfolder form `<root>/agents/<id>/` exists in that layer, `edit` and `remove` use it. `add` always writes `<root>/<id>/AGENT.md`.
+- `add(id:content:layer:)`: refuse an id that `AgentDefinitionRules.isValidID` refuses (`invalidID`). Refuse when the agent folder (either form) or, for `default`, the root `AGENT.md` already exists in the target layer (`alreadyExists`). An agent of the same id in a lower layer is not an error: the new agent overrides it. Make the folders, and write `AGENT.md`.
+- `edit(id:document:content:layer:)`: `document` is a relative path in the agent folder. The default is `AGENT.md`. Refuse an empty or absolute path, a path with a `..` component, and a path that `PathConfinement.isConfined` refuses (`unsafeDocument`). For `default`, refuse a document path whose first component is a valid agent id or `_skills`, `_rules` or `_partials`, because that file belongs to a different item. Refuse when the agent folder does not exist in the target layer (`notFound(id, layer)`). The error text names each layer where the agent is, from `AgentCatalog.definition(named:)` and its provenance, so the model can choose the correct layer or `add agent` an override. Make the folders of a new document. Replace the full text of the document.
+- `remove(id:layer:)`: refuse `default` (`cannotRemoveDefault`), because its folder is the layer root. Refuse when the folder does not exist in the target layer (`notFound`). Delete the agent folder.
+- Each write and each delete uses `NSFileCoordinator` (`coordinate(writingItemAt:options:)` with `.forReplacing` for a write, `.forDeleting` for a delete), as `AgentCatalogBuilder.coordinatedRead` does (`Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Registry/AgentCatalogBuilder.swift:329`). A coordination error gives `coordinationFailed(reason)`.
+- `AgentWriterError: Error, Equatable` with a corrective `message` for each case, in Simplified Technical English.
+- The writer does not reload. The caller calls `AgentRegistry.reload()`.
+
+Record in the report to testudoapp-75: the local layer has two forms, and `add` writes only `<id>/AGENT.md`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `add` writes `<user root>/<id>/AGENT.md` for `layer: .user` and `<project root>/<id>/AGENT.md` (in ACPAgent `<cwd>/.agents/<id>/AGENT.md`) for `layer: .project`.
+- [ ] `edit` of `default` with `layer: .user` replaces the root `AGENT.md` of the user layer.
+- [ ] `edit` with `document: "notes/a.md"` writes a document in the agent folder. `../x.md`, `/tmp/x.md` and a symbolic link out of the folder are refused, and no file changes.
+- [ ] `remove` deletes the agent folder of the target layer only. A copy in a different layer stays.
+- [ ] A write never goes to a `.defaults` layer or a marketplace layer.
+- [ ] Each error case gives its `AgentWriterError` and changes no file.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentWriterTests.swift` with temporary folders for a `defaults < user < project` stack: add in each layer, `alreadyExists`, override of a lower-layer id, `invalidID` (`Bad_ID`, `a--b`), edit of `AGENT.md` and of a new document, edit of `default`, edit in the dotfolder form `agents/<id>/`, `unsafeDocument` cases (with a symbolic link), `notFound` with the text that names the other layer, `remove`, `cannotRemoveDefault`, and `layerUnavailable` for a stack with no project layer.
+- [ ] After each write, `AgentRegistry.reload()` gives a catalog with the expected definition and provenance layer.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` gives no error and no warning. `swift test` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #step1 #AG-9
\ No newline at end of file

+- [ ] `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Registry/AgentWriter.swift:318` `reuse/reuse` — AgentFileCoordination.coordinate repeats the NSFileCoordinator wrap of AgentCatalogBuilder.coordinatedRead: the same coordinator call, the same NSError capture, the same error-to-throw mapping. Only the options (.forReplacing or .forDeleting versus [] reading) and the error type differ. A near-match was written as a parallel copy instead of being generalized, so a fix to the coordination pattern must now be made in two places. Generalize the shared coordination into one helper that takes the coordinator options and returns the coordinator error as a String, or a value the caller maps to its own error type (CoordinatedReadFailure for the read, AgentWriterError for the writer). Then both coordinatedRead and AgentFileCoordination.coordinate call it. If the error types or the access shapes genuinely cannot share a helper, keep the copy and state that reason in the doc comment, since the current comment only says the form is 'the same'.
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentWriterTests.swift:533` `swift/preconditions` — The snapshot helper silently replaces a file that cannot be read with empty Data. A read failure gives the same value before and after a write, so the no-change check in expectNoChange can pass without showing the failure. The condition is unexpected, because the file was just listed by subpathsOfDirectory, and no assertion or log records it. Read each file with `try Data(contentsOf: $0)` so a read error fails the test. If the fallback must stay, add `assertionFailure` and a log line that names the path, as the preconditions rule asks for an unexpected but recoverable condition.

It is the one `NSFileCoordinator` wrap. `AgentCatalogBuilder.coordinatedRead` maps the failure to `CoordinatedReadFailure`. `AgentFileCoordination.coordinate` in `AgentWriter.swift` maps it to `coordinationFailed`, and an error of the access to `writeFailed`.
+    - A coordinator that gives no error but does not run the access now gives a `Failure` (before: a read gave `nil` with no error).
+    - `AgentWriterTests.swift`: `snapshot()` reads each file with `try Data(contentsOf:)`. A plain `try` on each item of `subpathsOfDirectory` is not possible, because the list holds folders and symbolic links, and `Data(contentsOf:)` throws for a folder. Thus the new helper `snapshotContents(of:)` gives the destination path for a symbolic link, empty data for a folder (explicit, so a new or removed folder still changes the keys), and `try Data(contentsOf:)` for a file. Each read error now fails the test.
